emails = search_emails("TODOs for the week", "david.smith@bluesparrowtech.com")
if len(emails) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No email found from david.smith@bluesparrowtech.com with subject 'TODOs for the week'.")
email = emails[0]

class TodoActions(BaseModel):
    actions: list[str]

todos = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract a list of actionable tasks or requests from the following email. Only include clear, actionable items that can be executed by an assistant. Ignore greetings, sign-offs, or non-actionable content. Email content: {}".format(email.body),
    TodoActions
)

for action in todos.actions:
    print("Action item:", action)
